Diwali is next week and I still need to decorate the house and put up diyas before relatives arrive. What would you prioritize first?

Diwali is just around the corner, and it's great that you're eager to get everything ready. Considering you have a short time frame, I would recommend prioritizing the following tasks first: 1. **Cleaning and decluttering**: Give your house a thorough clean, especially the areas that will be visible to your relatives. This will help you create a good foundation for decorating and make the process more efficient. 2. **Setting up the main decorations**: Focus on putting up the main decorations, such as the rangoli designs, torans (door hangings), and any other large decorative items. This will give you a sense of the overall look and feel of your home. 3. **Preparing the diyas**: Make or buy the diyas and light them up in the evening to get a sense of the ambiance. You can also place them in strategic locations to create a warm and inviting glow. Once these tasks are complete, you can move on to the smaller details, such as: * Adding final touches to the decorations * Placing candles, lanterns, and other decorative items * Preparing traditional Diwali sweets and snacks * Setting up the puja area (if you have one) Remember, it's better to focus on the essential tasks first and then move on to the smaller details.
